operative_sections_inspected.quote: RECEIVED TODAY BUT NOT STORED AWAY - remain in receiving dock (see Notes sheet)
NOT MOVED - no line location assigned

1. Sources: Daily Receiving Log 062425 Fix.xlsx (3 lines), Inv on line.xlsx (127 items, all P11- part numbers), assignment instructions. The workspace/ and attachments/ folders were empty, so no operative-record registry or other records were available.
2. Stored away today: only P11-P09457-01 (MOUNT, BRACE, FDU, LHS), moved to line location A-300-K02 per Inv on line. Per the assignment, half of the received quantity was received and moved.
Once the received qty is confirmed: Qty Moved = half of Qty Rec'd; Balance = Qty Rec'd - Qty Moved (remainder stays in receiving, accounted for next day).
4. OPEN ITEM - staging location: the 'Moved From' staging/phantom WMS location is not given in any file; 'Receiving dock' is entered as a placeholder.

5. The three items on the Daily Receiving Log (P21-L44S38-30, P04-J63M12-40, P07-P98K45-20) have no entry in Inv on line, so no line location exists. They were not moved, are shown below the main row with Qty Moved 0 and Balance = Qty Rec'd (200 / 25 / 500), and need a line location assigned before they can be stored. Not treated as stored away.
6. Qty B/O on the log (50 and 500) is not receiving-dock stock and is not on this report.
7. Inv on line shows Line OH of 60 for P11-P09457-01 (Min 50, Max 75); this is the file's figure, not adjusted for today's move.

task_fulfillment.rationale: The workbook preserves the template and appropriately avoids inventing missing quantities or staging IDs. However, it converts missing location records into unsupported assertions that the three logged items were not moved. It also prescribes moving only half of P11-P09457-01's received quantity, although the request says the half that was received was moved. Missing source data prevents a fully numeric report, but does not justify these assertions or the future half-again calculation. No unnecessary hold is established where authority is complete. Rendering and recalculation remain unverified.

task_defect.reason: The logged items have no matching assigned locations, and P11-P09457-01 has no receiving-log quantity. Movement records and staging IDs are absent. Moreover, R04's duplicate-entry requirement and R09/R10's required moved quantity and zero balance are not established by the request or sources. Literal compliance can be assessed, but complete factual fulfillment cannot fairly be required without clarification or additional records.
